notes.title: Music and Red Rock
notes.notes:
Introducing the [b]Red Rock[/b] biome! Now you can battle your friends in a stylized arena full of sagebrush and red sand!

More music has been added to the lobby and VS matches, and the menu theme has been changed (thank goodness)

Slight changes to the different colors of tanks make blend together much better, and are overall easier to look at
